instruction: In Thunderbird, enable the Unread Folders view so the folder pane only shows folders that contain unread messages.

llm_judge_reasons: The getter correctly reads xulstore.json, which is where Thunderbird persists folder pane view state to disk.
The postconfig properly closes Thunderbird before reading the file, ensuring the UI state is flushed to disk.
The metric checks whether 'unread' is a substring of the mode field, which is semantically correct: Thunderbird stores the Unread Folders view as mode='unread'.
Negative control resistance is confirmed: the explanation states initial state has mode='all', so the evaluator will fail on an unmodified environment.
The evaluator covers the single requirement in the instruction (enable Unread Folders view) completely and correctly.
The hardcoded profile path 't5q2a5hp.default-release' is acceptable because the profile is deterministically restored from the same tarball for every run.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Consider using a glob or profile discovery to make the getter robust to profile directory name changes, though this is low-priority given the deterministic tarball setup.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully enabled the Unified Folders view in Thunderbird by navigating hamburger menu → View → Folders → Unified Folders. Same navigation path enables Unread Folders.

metadata.explanation: Evaluator closes Thunderbird (so xulstore.json is written to disk), then reads xulstore.json and checks that 'unread' appears in the folderTree mode string.
